about: Search engines SafeSearch can't reach, added since the last release. BlockNSFW downloads this file about twice a day and blocks these engines while 'Block other search engines' is on. The engines that ship are in shared/unsafe-search.js, which also describes the rule format. A rule here can only add an engine, never change or remove one that ships, and a rule naming an engine SafeSearch covers (Google, Bing, DuckDuckGo and the rest) is ignored.
